# AWAY Wills

> Award-winning, modern Will-writing service for parents and families in England and Wales

AWAY Wills is a digital-first Will-writing service that makes estate planning accessible, clear, and designed for modern families. We specialise in helping parents, unmarried partners, blended families, and anyone who wants to protect what matters most without outdated legal jargon or hidden fees. Our service combines expert guidance with secure digital tools, offering flexible appointments including evenings and weekends.

## Recognition and Awards

Winner of Will Writing Service of the Year 2025 (Innovation and Excellence Awards). Finalist for Estate Planning Firm of the Year - Boutique (British Wills and Probate Awards 2025). Silver Winner for Best New Business (Best Business Women Awards 2025). Featured in Metro, Daily Express, Marie Claire, Brood Magazine, London Daily News, London World, and Today's Wills and Probate.

Key features and benefits:

- Free 30-minute expert consultation with no obligation

- Plain English throughout - every Will includes a clause-by-clause explainer

- Fixed pricing with no hourly fees or hidden charges

- Designed for modern families including unmarried partners, step-children, and chosen family

- Video appointments at your convenience, including evenings and weekends

- Secure online portal for document review and approval

- Legally valid Wills for England and Wales

- Optional secure document storage

## Services

- [Will Writing](https://awaywills.com): Comprehensive Will-writing service for individuals and couples, covering guardianship, inheritance, funeral wishes, and asset protection

- [Free Consultation](https://calendly.com/awaywills/no-obligation-secure-my-legacy-11l): No-obligation 30-minute call to discuss your circumstances and explore options

- [Guide to Writing a Will](https://awaywills.com/writing-a-will-england-wales): Plain-English overview of how Wills work in England and Wales

## Who We Help

- Parents naming guardians for children

- Unmarried partners (common law marriage does not exist in England and Wales)

- Blended families and step-parents

- People protecting chosen family

- Anyone wanting to avoid outdated intestacy rules

- First-time Will writers who need clear guidance

- LGBTQ+ individuals and couples

## Our Process

1. **Free Consultation**: Book a no-obligation 30-minute call with a trained Will-writing professional

2. **Video Appointment**: Guided conversation where we take your instructions - no forms or prep work required

3. **Draft Preparation**: Receive case summary for approval, then we draft your Will

4. **Document Review**: Access secure online portal to review draft documents with plain English explanations

5. **Signing & Storage**: Clear instructions for execution, with optional secure storage available

## What Makes Us Different

- **Modern Family Focus**: Built for unmarried partners, blended families, and shared parenting arrangements

- **Plain English Explainer**: Every Will comes with a companion document explaining each clause in accessible language

- **Flexible Scheduling**: Evening and weekend appointments available for busy parents

- **Digital-First, Human-Led**: Professional guidance combined with secure online tools

- **Transparent Pricing**: Fixed fees, no hourly charges, no surprises

- **Fast Turnaround**: Efficient process that respects your time

## Common Questions Answered

- **Guardianship**: Formally record who will care for your children if both parents die

- **Unmarried Partners**: Protect partners who have no automatic inheritance rights under UK law

- **Asset Protection**: Future-proof inheritances from divorce, financial instability, or other life changes

- **Funeral Wishes**: Provide clear guidance to reduce pressure on loved ones

- **Step-Children & Chosen Family**: Ensure non-traditional family structures are legally recognised

- **LGBTQ+ Families**: Protect same-sex couples, trans individuals, and chosen family members

## Why This Matters

72% of UK adults don't have a Will - not because it doesn't matter, but because the process feels confusing or outdated. AWAY Wills exists to change that. We believe estate planning should be clear, accessible, and designed for how people actually live today, not how the law assumed families looked in 1837.
